# Optional App Store "What's New" override. Keep this file comment-only between
# releases so dist/app-store-release-notes.sh derives notes from commits.
#
# To override one release, add `# Release version: x.y.z` and the user-facing
# text below it. The script rejects missing or stale version markers before any
# store upload.
# Release version: 0.2.25

• Arcade brings Chess and Pong to desktop, Android and web communities with games enabled.
• Move Arcade like any channel, see active lobby counts, and hide its badge by muting it.
• Find friends by name in lobbies, choose from illustrated games, and invite members by username or nickname.
• Idle games show a countdown and are removed after seven days without player activity on updated community servers.
• Voice participant profiles load more reliably, and decrypted video data is cleared when attachments or accounts change.
